questions.question: Which committee, set up in 1957, recommended a three-tier Panchayati Raj system?
questions.rationale: Balwant Rai Mehta (1957) proposed Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti and Zila Parishad. Ashok Mehta (1977) proposed only two tiers.

questions.question: The Ashok Mehta Committee recommended which structure for rural local government?
options: Two-tier: Zila Parishad and Mandal Panchayat
Three-tier with Gram Sabha at the top
questions.rationale: The 1977 committee proposed a two-tier model. The three-tier pattern belongs to Balwant Rai Mehta.

questions.question: The Sarkaria Commission examined:
questions.rationale: Set up in 1983, with Justice R.S. Sarkaria as chair, it reported in 1988 on centre-state relations.

questions.question: Which commission recommended 27 per cent reservation for OBCs in central government posts?
questions.rationale: The Mandal Commission, headed by B.P. Mandal, reported in 1980. Kothari is about education and Sachar about Muslims.

questions.question: The Kothari Commission (1964-66) is associated with:
questions.rationale: D.S. Kothari headed the Education Commission, which backed the 10+2+3 pattern and the three-language formula.

questions.question: Which committee led to the creation of the Central Vigilance Commission in 1964?
questions.rationale: The Santhanam Committee of 1962 examined corruption, and the CVC followed in 1964.

questions.question: Which of the following is correctly matched?
questions.rationale: Justice J.C. Shah investigated excesses of the Emergency. Liberhan examined the Babri Masjid demolition and Sachar studied Muslims.

questions.question: The Sachar Committee, which reported in 2006, studied the condition of:
questions.rationale: Justice Rajinder Sachar chaired the committee on the social, economic and educational status of Muslims.

questions.question: Which one is the odd one out among these education bodies?
questions.rationale: Sarkaria dealt with centre-state relations. The other three studied education.

questions.question: The States Reorganisation Commission (1953) was headed by:
questions.rationale: Fazl Ali chaired it with K.M. Panikkar and H.N. Kunzru. Its report (1955) led to the States Reorganisation Act, 1956.

questions.question: Which statement about Panchayati Raj and committees is correct?
options: Balwant Rai Mehta recommended two tiers in 1977
Ashok Mehta recommended three tiers in 1957
Balwant Rai Mehta (1957) recommended three tiers and Ashok Mehta (1977) two tiers
questions.rationale: Remember B3 and A2: Balwant Rai Mehta three-tier, Ashok Mehta two-tier.

questions.question: The Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution after the recommendations of which committee?
questions.rationale: The Swaran Singh Committee (1976) led to the 42nd Amendment adding Fundamental Duties.

questions.question: The Simon Commission of 1927 was opposed in India mainly because:
options: It proposed ending the Legislative Councils
It was set up after independence
questions.rationale: All its members were British, which prompted the 'Simon Go Back' protests.

questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched by year?
questions.rationale: Sarkaria was set up in 1983 and Punchhi in 2007, both on centre-state relations. The other pairs scramble dates.

questions.question: The Inter-State Council under Article 263 was set up in 1990 following a recommendation of which commission?
questions.rationale: The Sarkaria Commission had recommended a permanent Inter-State Council.
